LESSON: PICTURE READING.

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Picture reading.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Picture reading., part of Reading in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How can we use the road safely?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Picture reading. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving is enhanced as the learner works on correctly identifying pictures of different

means of transport.

• Self-efficacy is enhanced as the learner matches correctly pictures of different means of transport and the people involved

in them with the others in class watching and listening.

Values:
• Responsibility is enhanced as the learner correctly reads pictures and matches pictures correctly.

• Unity is enhanced as the learner works with others in a group with agreement to match pictures.

113

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion is enhanced as the leaner with others work in groups in matching pictures and playing games harmoniously

and without conflicts.

mathematics they match numbers.

Suggested learning resources: charts with pictures of different means of transport, assistive devices, multipurpose

communication board
